action->Convincing Telepathy.name: Convincing Telepathy
action->Convincing Telepathy.description: When a conqueror worm communicates telepathically, its overwhelming will bolsters its lies. Its DECEPTION checks and DECEPTION DCs aren't penalized for elaborate or unbelievable telepathic lies.

action->Mental Invader.name: Mental Invader
action->Mental Invader.description:
Desencadenante A criatura communicates telepathically with the conqueror worm (even to respond to the conqueror worm's telepathy or through a mental conjuro like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.R9xqCBblkS5KE4y7]{Sending}) or fails a tirada de salvación against a mental conjuro cast by the conqueror worm

Efecto The conqueror worm infects the mind of the criatura, allowing it to mentally contact the criatura from afar. The criatura must attempt a @Check[will|dc:48] tirada de salvación and is temporarily immune for 1 year.

Éxito crítico El objetivo is unaffected and can't be affected by the conqueror worm's Mental Invader ever again.

Éxito El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 1} for 1 minuto.

Fallo As success, and the conqueror worm can target the criatura with telepathy and mental conjuros regardless of distance, so long as the worm and target are on the same plane. Este bond is permanent and can be broken only by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YfJTXyVGzLhM6V8U]{Miracle}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish}, or similar magic. The conqueror worm can maintain a maximum of 10 connections with Mental Invader. If another criatura would be infected, the worm must elige to one of its existing connections end, or if the worm prefers to keep its current 10 connections, the new criatura isn't infected instead.

Fallo crítico As failure, and for as long as the mental link lasts, el objetivo uses an outcome one degree of success worse than the result of its tirada de salvación against mental conjuros cast by the conqueror worm.

action->Telepathic Escape.name: Telepathic Escape
action->Telepathic Escape.description: When the conqueror worm dies, it telepathically projects its consciousness into a criatura infected by its Mental Invader ability and who is on the same plane as the conqueror worm. The criatura must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:48|name:Mental Invader] salvación or it is overtaken by the conqueror worm. Este has the same effect as the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wU6hNzK8Yfqdmc8m]{Possession} conjuro with an unlimited duration, except the conqueror worm has wholly foregone its physical body. A host body possessed by a conqueror worm undergoes terrible changes. Every day, the host must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:48] or become permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 1} (or increase its stupefied value by 1) and increasingly pale, balding, and bloated. When the host reaches stupefied 4, an ectoplasmic cocoon forms around it. Over the next 24 horas, the host undergoes a swift metamorphosis and emerges as a new conqueror worm with all the memories of its previous incarnation. At this point, the host is dead and can't be restored except by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YfJTXyVGzLhM6V8U]{Miracle}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish}, or similar magic. Before that point, however, this horrid transformation can be ended by any effect that expels the conqueror worm's possession, meaning would be slayers of a conqueror worm had best locate its consciousness and end the possession before it's too late and the worm rises again.

action->True Seeing.name: True Seeing
action->True Seeing.description: El conqueror worm es under el effects de 9th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uqlxMQQeSGWEVjki]{Truesight} at todos times.

It can't use Breath Weapon again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Breath Weapon]]{1d4 rounds}.

Estos Golpes count as one attack for the gray death's multiple attack penalización, and the penalización doesn't increase until after the attacks.

action->Life Sap.name: Life Sap
action->Life Sap.description: A criatura damaged by the gray death's hand Golpe must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:42] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 1}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralizado} for 1 asalto on a critical failure.

action->Resentful Possession.name: Resentful Possession
action->Resentful Possession.description:
Frecuencia una vez por asalto

Efecto The gray death chooses a living criatura within 30 pies. El objetivo must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:42] salvación or a fragment of embittered soul-stuff lodges within el objetivo's spirit and turns it against its allies. While el objetivo has this fragment, it doesn't count as anyone's ally for the purposes of providing flanking, and a would-be ally casting a conjuro that normally works only on an ally on the criatura must succeed at a DC 42 counteract check (level 20) or the conjuro has no effect. Desencadenante The Gray Gardener assassin rolls a failure (but not a critical failure) on a Will save against an effect with the mental or fear rasgo

Requisitos The Gray Gardener assassin's features are obscured by a mask or hood

Efecto The Gray Gardener assassin takes @Damage[3d8[mental]] daño, and the tirada de salvación is a success.

action->Instant Opening.name: Abertura instantánea
action->Instant Opening.description: The Gray Gardener assassin distracts a criatura within 30 pies, using a few choice words or gestures. The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} against the assassin's attacks until the end of the assassin's next turn. Depending on the distraction, this action gains either the auditory or the visual rasgo.

Este effect lasts until the mark dies or the assassin uses Mark for Death again. The assassin gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} the mark and on DECEPTION checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint} against the mark. The assassin's melee and ranged Golpes gain the deadly d8 arma rasgos when attacking the mark.

Efecto The assassin applies a poison to the arma.

action->Surprise Attack.description: On the first round of combat, criaturas that haven't acted yet are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} to the Gray Gardener assassin.

Desencadenante The director general's turn begins

action->Whispers of Superiority.name: Whispers of Superiority
action->Whispers of Superiority.description: The director general utters a few words to a non-asustado target within 60 pies that can hear them, bolstering el objetivo's indignation of cowards. El objetivo criatura must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:39] salvación, or it doesn't count asustado criaturas as allies and can't Aid them or flank with them. action->Consecration Vulnerability.name: Consecration Vulnerability
action->Consecration Vulnerability.description: A Gray Gardener enforcer in a place of worship dedicated to a non-evil deity or on sacred ground, such as an area blessed by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.y3jlOfgsQH1JjkJE]{Anointed Ground}, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1}.

action->Gardener's Resolve.name: La resolución del jardinero
action->Gardener's Resolve.description:
Desencadenante The Gray Gardener enforcer rolls a failure (but not a critical failure) on a Will save against an effect with the mental or fear rasgo

Requisitos The Gray Gardener enforcer's features are obscured by a mask or hood

Efecto The Gray Gardener enforcer takes @Damage[3d8[mental]] daño, and the tirada de salvación is a success.

action->Nourishing Feast.name: Nourishing Feast
action->Nourishing Feast.description: The Gray Gardener enforcer spends 1 hora consuming 1 Bulk of raw meat to reverse their body's putrescence. For 1 hora, the Gray Gardener enforcer appears to be a pale, bloated human. They have an automatic result of 32 on DECEPTION checks and DCs to pass as a non-mortic human. While under the effects of Nourishing Feast, Rotting Flesh ceases to function.

action->Rotting Flesh.name: Rotting Flesh
action->Rotting Flesh.description: Any criatura that hits the Gray Gardener enforcer with an ataque sin armas, tries to Grapple them, or otherwise touches the gurgist is covered with rotten flesh and putrid fluids. The criatura must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:36] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 2} on a critical failure).

action->Chain Garotte.name: Chain Garotte
action->Chain Garotte.description: The Gray Gardener enforcer's spiked chain Golpe deals @Damage[2d8[bleed]], and they can use it to GRAB up to two foes. The enforcer can still attack with their spiked chain if they GRAB one criatura, but not when they GRAB two.

action->Death Gasp.name: Death Gasp
action->Death Gasp.description:
The Gray Gardener enforcer draws in a deep breath and holds it, temporarily suspending their biological processes and becoming undead. The Gray Gardener enforcer gains the undead rasgo and becomes immune to bleed, death effects, disease, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralizado}, poison, and sleep. Any such effects the Gray Gardener is currently suffering from are suspended but take effect again once they take a breath. Death Gasp lasts as long as the Gray Gardener enforcer holds their breath.

action->Golem Antimagic.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-family-ability-glossary.Item.r34QDwKiWZoVymJa]

harmed by acid ([[/r {9d10}]]{9d8 daño}, [[/r {3d8}]]{3d8 daño} from areas or daño persistente); healed by electricity (area [[/r 3d8[healing]]] Puntos de Golpe); ralentizado by fire

A golem is immune to conjuros and magical abilities other than its own, but each type of golem is affected by a few types of magic in special ways. Estos exceptions are listed in shortened form in the golem's stat block, with the full rules appearing here. If an entry lists multiple types (such as "cold and water"), either type of conjuro can affect the golem.

  • Harmed By Any magic of this type that targets the golem causes it to take the listed amount of daño (this daño has no type) instead of the usual effect. If the golem starts its turn in an area of magic of this type or is affected by a persistent effect of the appropriate type, it takes the daño listed in the parenthetical.

Miss Whisper.name: Miss Whisper
Miss Whisper.publicNotes:
Ages ago, when this cycle of the multiverse was still adolescent, a cabal of psychopomps who already felt bored and restrained in their role of ushering souls to their ultimate resting place rebelled against their station. It was this corruption of the cycle of souls that spawned the first sahkils.

Ambivalent to the prescribed order of the multiverse and spiteful of mortals, sahkils delight in spreading fear and unease to all beings, clogging up the metaphysical cycle with anxiety-ridden mortals too scared to achieve their potential. Estos fiends have drastically changed from their dedicated psychopomp predecessors. They are criaturas of spite and torment, fear and disgust. They exploit the most common and rare fears for their own perverse satisfaction, and they want nothing more than to frighten mortals and make them quetion their reason for existence.

Most sahkils lurk on the Ethereal Plane, but they frequently invade the Material Plane to torment mortals and spread terror. They use their innate ability to slip between the veils of the Ethereal and Material effortlessly, often stalking their targets for days or weeks before enacting their devious plots.

Pakalchis strive to intensify their preys' inherent insecurity over personal and emotional bonds, playing on the threat of those relationships falling into ruin. Estos sahkils are among the most manipulative of their kind, pulling strings both literal and figurative on their victims over stretched-out periods of time, exhilarating in the despair and fear for as long as possible.

action->Easy to Call.description: Un sahkil's level es considered 2 lower for el purpose de being conjured by el @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2ykmAVKrsAWcazcC]{Binding Circle} ritual (y potentially otro rituals, at el DJ's discretion), but es always free a ataque o leave instead de negotiate unless el primary caster's prueba es un critical success.

action->Focused Force.name: Focused Force
action->Focused Force.description: Unlike most incorporeal criaturas, a tumblak can make Strength-based checks against physical criaturas and objects if it chooses, though such criaturas still can't make Strength-based checks against the tumblak.

action->Gasping Aura.name: Gasping Aura
action->Gasping Aura.description: 100 pies. Las criaturas within the aura must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:37] salvación. On a failure, they can't breathe and must hold their breath to avoid suffocation until they leave the aura. The tumblak can activate or deactivate the aura with a single free action, which has the concentrate rasgo.

action->Claustrophobic Nightmares.name: Claustrophobic Nightmares
action->Claustrophobic Nightmares.description: A criatura @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigado} by the tumblak's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Uqj344bezBq3ESdq]{Nightmare} conjuro is subject to paralyzing glimpses of being buried alive. Anyone using an effect that would remove the fatigued condition through a means other than a full night's rest must succeed on a DC 44 counteract check or the fatigued condition isn't removed. When the fatigued criatura enters a stressful situation, such as rolling initiative in combat or entering a high-stakes negotiation, it is affected by Entombing Echoes.

action->Entombing Echoes.name: Entombing Echoes
action->Entombing Echoes.description: A criatura struck by the tumblak's fist or impacted by Claustrophobic Nightmares must succeed on a @Check[will|dc:44] salvación or feel itself confined on all sides. The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Inmovilizado} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} until it Escapes (DC 44).

action->Skip Between.name: Skip Between
action->Skip Between.description: Tumblak mueve de el Material Plane a el Ethereal Plane o vice versa, con el effects de @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.D2nPKbIS67m9199U]{Ethereal Jaunt} except el effect tiene un unlimited duration y puede be Dismissed. Un summoned sahkil puede't usar Skip Between.

action->Anonymity.description: The worm prophet has a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to DECEPTION checks and tiradas de salvación to conceal their identity and a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to their DECEPTION DC against effects that ferret out information about the worm prophet's identity.

action->Invaded.name: Invaded
action->Invaded.description: El worm prophet es subject a el conqueror worm's mental Invader effect.

action->Capture Spirit.name: Capture Spirit
action->Capture Spirit.description:
Desencadenante A target affected by one of the worm prophet's necromancy conjuros dies within 60 pies of the worm prophet

Efecto The worm prophet harnesses a bit of the departing victim's soul, and the worm prophet is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Acelerado} 1 for 1 minuto. They can use this extra action only to Dar un paso, Zancada, or Sustain a Spell.

action->Steady Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento de conjuros firme
action->Steady Spellcasting.description: Si un reaction would disrupt el worm prophet's spellcasting action, el worm prophet attempts un @Check[flat|dc:15|showDC:owner]. con un exito, el action isn't disrupted.

Efecto The Gray Gardener assassin takes @Damage[3d8[mental]] daño, and the tirada de salvación is a success.

action->Instant Opening.name: Abertura instantánea
action->Instant Opening.description: The Gray Gardener assassin distracts a criatura within 30 pies, using a few choice words or gestures. The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} against the assassin's attacks until the end of the assassin's next turn. Depending on the distraction, this action gains either the auditory or the visual rasgo.

action->Mark for Death.name: Marcar para la muerte
action->Mark for Death.description: The Gray Gardener assassin designates a single criatura they can see and hear as their mark. Este effect lasts until the mark dies or the assassin uses Mark for Death again. The assassin gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} the mark and on DECEPTION checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint} against the mark. The assassin's melee and ranged Golpes gain the deadly d8 arma rasgos when attacking the mark.

action->Poison Weapon.name: Envenenar arma
action->Poison Weapon.description:
Requisitos The Gray Gardener assassin is wielding a piercing or slashing arma and has a free hand

Efecto The assassin applies a poison to the arma.

action->Quick Draw.name: Desenvainado rápido
action->Quick Draw.description: The Gray Gardener assassin Interacts to draw a arma and then Golpes with that arma.

action->Surprise Attack.description: On the first round of combat, criaturas that haven't acted yet are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} to the Gray Gardener assassin.
